style: Hand-painted 2D xianxia, finely gilded jade, strong miniature silhouettes, true alpha transparency.
layout: Regular 2x2 blades/hostile and 4x2 impact source kits. Technical whole-cell downsampling and 16px padding; AtlasTexture clips its own region.

kits.blades: Square transparent 2x2 production sprite kit. Top-left: one heavenly jian pointing STRAIGHT DOWN, sapphire-silver blade, antique gold cloud-carved guard, tiny jade jewel, lavish but strong readable silhouette. Top-right: one Yin crescent spiritual blade pointing RIGHT, turquoise jade and silver, carved gold hilt, flowing short jade ribbon. Bottom-left: one Yang crescent spiritual blade pointing RIGHT, amber-gold and ivory, carved gold hilt, short molten gold ribbon. Bottom-right: one open circular icy-blue celestial ground sigil, intricate fine gold cloud-carved rim, transparent aperture, absolutely no polygon or hexagon outline.
kits.hostile: Square transparent 2x2 production enemy attack VFX kit, distinct from player's skills. Top-left: an ominous open circular gilded dark indigo talisman formation seal, fine cloud filigree with small warning runes, 55% diameter transparent center, NO hexagon, NO angular polygon outline. Top-right: one luminous indigo-violet talisman comet flying RIGHT, ornate scroll-paper core bound with crimson-gold ribbon and a short wispy tail. Bottom-left: one dramatic vertical hostile lightning bolt striking DOWN, painterly jagged branching indigo-white core with crimson-violet smoke, all forks inside cell. Bottom-right: an explosive circular ink-and-qi wave, violet jade shards and gilded cloud wisps swirling outward, transparent center, painterly irregular shockwave edge, no regular polygon.
kits.impacts: Wide 4x2 production hit VFX kit, eight distinct isolated mini illustrations. Row one from left: (1) jade silver diagonal crescent slash with tiny gold fragments, (2) orange gold fire-petal explosion with charred crimson sparks, (3) cyan blue jagged branching electric impact, (4) TWO crossing crescent slashes turquoise and amber with a small taiji-like swirling center. Row two from left: (5) heavenly sword-ground puncture with rising sapphire shards and a narrow gold-white vertical plume, (6) green gold Bagua qi blossom with mist petals and ink-cloud whorl NO hard polygon frame, (7) curved gold-jade binding knot bursting into emerald fragments, (8) dark violet-silver piercing lance impact with narrow elongated splitting star. Each is lavish hand-painted energy, subtle translucent smoke, sharp light core, fragments with carved jade texture. No opaque backplate or opaque center blob.
